evals.prompt: I want to interview my father about his whole life for a private family record, nothing that will ever be published. He had a difficult relationship with his own dad and I think that's important to include.
evals.expected_output: Structures the project by era/theme, uses sensory/anchored elicitation technique rather than generic questions, asks permission before probing the difficult father relationship, and doesn't self-censor the topic on the narrator's behalf.

evals.prompt: During the interview my dad told a story about a business failure that contradicts what my mom always said happened. Should I just go with my mom's version since she remembers it better?
evals.expected_output: Recommends keeping both accounts with reliability tags rather than resolving the conflict by picking one version.
